description: Asset role was assigned by matching the asset filename slug against an allowlist of role keywords. Slug matching is not source inspection; the actual asset usage is defined in cartridge code.

evidence_payload.extracted_fact: arrow_projectile.png is the projectile sprite for Archer's Revenge.
evidence_payload.interpretation: The asset slug names the role.

why_this_fails.structural_problem: asset_role is derived from the slug regex/allowlist; no source file shows the cartridge code that actually loads this asset. Slug allowlists cannot stand in for source inspection.
